subject: Rephase: MAP timeline and evaluation cadence — proposed tactical rebaseline
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbuslabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick — evaluation window needs shifting

Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked off our internal eval yesterday and a couple of blockers surfaced that will materially slow the scheduled test runs:

- Our SOC2 review team requested a deeper sample of audit logs before allowing the sandbox to run full ingestion (they've asked for retention settings to be validated).
- The security lead is tied up with an unrelated remediation and has asked to push the 2nd-week performance runs by at least one week.

I wanted to flag this early — do you have flexibility on the MAP milestones? If we can't start the heavy evaluation until Apr 2, we risk the previously agreed go-live target. Raj and I want to avoid pile-on escalation; asking whether Redwood can accommodate a short rebaseline and what that would mean for credits / staging windows.

Appreciate quick guidance so we can decide whether to open procurement for an extension.

— Elena
Head of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Labs

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.csv (stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick — evaluation window needs shifting

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the SOC2 list. Short answer: yes, we can absorb a one-week shift to the MAP but need to align on three things before confirming:

1) Acceptance test reordering: we can move performance runs + load tests to the week of Apr 2, but we'd like to run a light yes/no functional pass on Apr 1 to keep momentum.
2) Staging access window: we'll extend the sandbox reservation by 7 days at no charge; additional extension beyond that will need a small usage credit.
3) Escalation headroom: if retention validation pushes more work into the verification window, we reserve the right to trigger a canary rollback and recommend an incremental rollout post-go-live.

I'll loop in Jonas and Naomi for the formal update to the MAP and ask Marcus to draft the revised risk log entry and a one-page contingency for executive review.

Proposed next steps:
- I will send an updated MAP PDF by EOD with shifted milestones and exact dates.
- Elena / Raj: confirm SOC2 evidence ETA (you mentioned Mar 28 in the demo).
- Jonas: can you slot a 30-min alignment with their security lead tomorrow?

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus-MAP-proposed-v2.pdf (stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick — evaluation window needs shifting

Brief internal sync notes — adding for the risk log:

- Impact: 1-week shift to heavy eval pushes the final acceptance gate from Apr 18 -> Apr 25, which in turn moves the first production slice to May 3 assuming no further slippage.
- Probability: medium (security teams commonly request deeper audits).
- Mitigation actions (short list):
  * Provide temporary retention profile that matches Nimbus' SOC2 sampling so they can progress with ingestion tests. Marcus to prepare config by EOD.
  * Offer a canary ramp plan for May 3 go-live to limit blast radius.
  * Propose a one-time credit equivalent to 5% of the expected Q2 usage if final go-live slips beyond May 10 (sales to approve).

Naomi — please start a short deck for execs: slides for "what changed", "risk exposure", and "recommended remedy + ask". Marcus — add the retention test config and expected ops time.

I'll take the alignment call with Nimbus security tomorrow at 10am PT. Camila — if you can include the revised MAP link in your reply we can mark the risk entry P1 and circulate to CS for readiness.

— Jonas
Director, Solutions Engineering

Quoted: "On Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:00:00 -07:00, Camila Reyes wrote:
> Proposed next steps:
> - I will send an updated MAP PDF by EOD with shifted milestones and exact dates.
> - Elena / Raj: confirm SOC2 evidence ETA (you mentioned Mar 28 in the demo).
> - Jonas: can you slot a 30-min alignment with their security lead tomorrow?"

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick — evaluation window needs shifting

Attaching the retention profile + test plan outline (I pasted the key snippet below). If Nimbus can approve the sample window we can let ingestion run this week and not wait until Apr 2.

Retention test config (summary):
- Sample window: 30 days of logs redacted — hashed identifiers only.
- KV-cache TTL: 24 hours for staging; full prod TTL remains 30 days.
- Access: read-only temporary credentials mapped to Nimbus audit group.

Ops estimate: 4 engineer-hours to stage + 2 hours to validate with Nimbus. If they approve today we can keep the MAP as-is and avoid the one-week slip.

Marcus Lin
SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evaluation-schedule-2028Q2.xlsx (stub)

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuslabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick — evaluation window needs shifting

Camila / team — thanks, that helped. Two quick updates:

1) Our SOC2 team agreed to the redacted 30-day sample. They want confirmation of how identifiers will be hashed (Marcus, can you share the hashing algorithm snippet?).
2) Procurement (Raj) asked whether the sandbox extension credit can be formalized as a line item in a change order so we can route approval faster.

If you can push the MAP PDF with the two options (AS-IS + 1-week rebaseline) we'll share both with procurement and the security lead.

Elena

Quoted: "On Thu, 22 Mar 2028 14:22:00 -07:00 Marcus Lin wrote:

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuslabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick — evaluation window needs shifting

Elena / Raj — finalizing the decision vector and recording here for the exec docket. Summary and outcome:

- Status: Nimbus validated the 30-day redacted sample and Marcus shared the hashing snippet; ingestion started Mar 30 in staging.
- Decision: Procurement chose the AS-IS path (no formal week-long rebaseline); they requested a formal Change Order template capturing the one-time sandbox extension credit (5% credit cap if go-live slips past May 10).
- Action items:
  * Naomi: publish the short exec slide deck (why the window almost slipped, mitigations, ask) and add the updated MAP link.
  * Camila (me): upload the signed change order template and DocuSign link below.
  * Marcus: monitor the first three days of ingestion and post hourly error telemetry to the shared drive.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/s/abcd-1234-NIM-1784 (change order draft)
MAP (final): https://redwood-cloud.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/sales/NIM-1784/MAP-final

We will treat the risk entry as P1-watch until May 10. If we see any evidence of further slippage I will escalate to the regional VP.

Thanks all — closing the immediate loop.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
